# Rebbe Search Proof Delta

The Awtsmoos renews every proof before confidence can pretend to be sight;
Awtsmoos.com keeps the search chamber honest by measuring each vessel in light.

## Observed green evidence

- All rewritten search JavaScript parses.
- Search result rendering no longer uses dynamic result `innerHTML`.
- Active search path no longer contains `9999` or `10001` layer values.
- Search CSS is statically imported from the Rebbe runtime manifest.
- `git diff --check` is clean.

## Observed delta

- `search-shell.css` is 125 lines.
- `search-controls.css` is 123 lines.
- `search-results.css` is 149 lines.
- `SearchPanel.js` still uses one trusted template `innerHTML` mount; keep under review but it is not archive-data interpolation.
- A separate runtime stylesheet injector exists in `ui/browser/tracks/styles.js`; this becomes next-wave work after search closure.

## NEXT_ACTION

Split the three oversized search CSS owners by responsibility without compressing comments or rules. Then create focused regression contracts and run the complete Rebbe test set.
